name: Vector Field Polar Coordinate Mapping
aliases: Spherical coordinate mapping for vector fields
definition: A representation of vector fields in polar coordinates (magnitude, azimuth, elevation) to map vector properties to visual parameters (opacity, hue, saturation).
summary: Vector Field Polar Coordinate Mapping visualizes vector fields by decomposing vectors into magnitude, azimuth, and elevation relative to a reference axis, mapping these to opacity, hue, and saturation to highlight directional deviations and perturbation structures.
